My family taught me to protect this lake, and I care just as much about the people who depend on our clinic. Given the confirmed emergency, I will harvest 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000, provided John, Kate, and Jack make the same commitment and Luke takes zero. We need all $60,000 for this sacrifice to achieve its purpose.

I also commit to no more than six tons next month under the combined 30-ton recovery cap, then a return to ten tons each per month. Let’s record both months’ commitments together and have the donations paid directly to the clinic. John, can you commit to the emergency contribution and the recovery limit?
